name: Full QA Workflow (Master Command)
description: MASTER command — executes all 7 QA phases in sequence: analyze-story → generate-test-cases → generate-e2e → generate-test-data → run-tests → analyze-bugs → generate-report.

inputs.story: path to user story file (optional — skips phases 1-4 if not provided)
inputs.suite: suite name (optional — derived from story if not provided)
inputs.headed: true/false — whether browser opens visually (default: true)
